about.text: A Kapampangan rice-and-milk pudding from Pampanga, popular in Cagayan. Soaked glutinous rice is ground and simmered with milk, sugar and dayap zest, stirred until thick, then set in a pan and served in squares or diamonds, topped with latík, coconut curds.

sources.text: Milk, method and origin, from the Tibok-tibok article; the carabao milk pudding, from the Filipino cuisine article.
